summary.intent: Check which of 9 pending planning todos were resolved by recent commits (primarily PR #500), then clean up the todo tracking by moving resolved ones to completed and rescoping the partial one, committing everything to a docs branch.
summary.outcome: A 9-agent parallel workflow verified each todo against live code: 2 fully resolved (both by PR #500), 1 partially resolved, 6 still open. Resolved todos were moved to `.planning/todos/completed/`, the partial todo was rescoped to its remaining item, and all changes were committed to a docs branch.

repo: `.planning/todos/` completion convention is just moving files to `completed/` directory — no resolution frontmatter or status markers are added.
PR #500 (commit 383e856cb) closed two todos: encrypted itemName at rest (M1 security finding) and consolidated SDK shared-folder write routing.
The intel directory inside `.planning/` is an auto-generated placeholder ('Do not edit by hand') with no entries — should not be committed.
Legacy plaintext `item_name` rows in the shares table are intentionally left unbackfilled because the server is zero-knowledge; a future PATCH endpoint is planned.

code.finding: New `item_name_encrypted` bytea column added in PR #500 for ECIES-wrapped share name; plaintext column retained only for legacy rows.
Client-side ECIES wraps item.name with recipient pubkey via `wrapKey()` and sends ciphertext-only; server never sees plaintext for new shares.
Still calls viem's standalone `verifyMessage()` with no `publicClient` — EOA-only, no ERC-1271 contract-wallet support.
`buildFromFolderTree()` is fully synchronous: `removeAll()` then blocking `addAll()` with no chunking, batching, or Web Worker offload.
Calls full `buildFromFolderTree()` on every palette open; no incremental update path exists.
Still manually unwraps `folderKeyEncrypted`/`ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted`, duplicating the SDK's unwrap — remaining open item from the partial todo after item 1 landed.
Documented deferral comment for a future PATCH endpoint to lazily backfill legacy plaintext itemName rows.
Migration adds nullable bytea column to both `shares` and `share_invites` — additive and idempotent.

workflow: Fan-out workflow with one verifier agent per todo is highly effective for batch todo triage — 9 agents ran in parallel, each opening live files to confirm presence/absence of the described problem rather than guessing from commit titles.
Task notification output can be truncated; always check the full output file path returned in the notification when result size may exceed the inline limit.
Checking `git log -S '<symbol>'` per todo is a reliable way to distinguish genuine implementation commits from session-checkpoint commits that merely contain todo text.

friction: Workflow result was truncated in the task-notification inline `result` field; required a separate `Read` of the `.output` file to get all 9 verdicts.
The auto-generated intel directory appeared as untracked noise in git status during the commit step, requiring care not to accidentally stage it.
open_items: `useFolderNavigation.ts:242-249` still manually unwraps `folderKeyEncrypted`/`ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted`, duplicating SDK logic — the remaining item from the rescoped partial todo.
ERC-1271 contract-wallet authentication: SIWE service is EOA-only, no `createPublicClient` or `eth_getCode` detection.
CRDT-based IPNS inbox for serverless share discovery: entirely unstarted research item; PR #500 moved in the opposite direction.
Async/incremental search index: `buildFromFolderTree()` is still a synchronous full-rebuild called on every palette open.
Alternative MFA factor types (passkey/PRF, password-derived, secondary OAuth): only device-share + mnemonic exist.
IPNS signature storage review (S1/S2/S3 findings): all three still present in live code.
Pin GitHub Actions workflow refs to immutable SHAs: 0 of 116 refs pinned.
Lazy backfill of legacy plaintext `item_name` rows in shares table: deferred pending a future PATCH endpoint (`shares.service.ts:400-407`).
